column1: # Budgets of the helper commands (A229, issue #173 package A): build-record, friction report, calibrate, lessons and rules, the most external processes one run of the
# path may start on the fixture of tests/bench/helper-procs.mjs (a PATH shim counts them, the measured command itself included: no clock is read). max_procs = the
# measured count (REPEAT=3 median) plus a margin of max(2, 25 percent). before = the shell form of 0.0.62 on the same fixture (the build-record row counts the two
# commands of the fixture, which run as `timeout` plus `sh`). tests/bench/helper-budgets.test.mjs fails above a row. Raise a row only with a decision in docs/decisions.md.
